changelog:
Initial release: persuasive copywriting techniques and frameworks for marketing

- Introduces comprehensive playbook for writing persuasive copy for landing pages, ads, emails, and sales pages.
- Covers popular copywriting frameworks: AIDA, PAS, and FAB.
- Provides actionable tips for headlines, CTAs, objection handling, emotional triggers, and proof.
- Includes real-world examples and formulas for immediate use.
- Designed for solopreneurs and marketers who want higher conversions without sounding sleazy.
summary: Write persuasive copy for landing pages, emails, ads, sales pages, and marketing materials. Use when you need to write headlines, CTAs, product descriptions, ad copy, email sequences, or any text meant to drive action. Covers copywriting formulas (AIDA, PAS, FAB), headline writing, emotional triggers, objection handling in copy, and A/B testing. Trigger on "write copy", "copywriting", "landing page copy", "headline", "write a sales page", "ad copy", "email copy", "persuasive writing", "how to write [marketing text]".
